question: The perimeter and area of a rectangular sheet are 94 m and 420 m² respectively. The length of the diagonal will be:
solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter and area of a rectangular sheet are 94 m and 420 m2

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/582c15b3ad6bbc6940c87ced2ea0866b761ff807805536878d95ba7833bb3ff7.png] 

Perimeter of a rectangle = 2(l + b)

Area of a rectangle = (l × b)

Diagonal of a rectangle = √(l2 + b2)

l = Length

b = Breadth

**Calculation:**

2(l + b) = 94

⇒ (l + b) = 47

(l + b)² = 47²

⇒ l² + b² + 2l.b = 2209

⇒ l2 + b2 + 840 = 2209

⇒ l2 + b2 = 1369

⇒ l2 + b2 = 37²

⇒ Diagonal² = 372

⇒ Diagonal = 37

**∴ The length of the diagonal will be 37 m**
